# Kitty Giraudel

> Personal site of Kitty Giraudel, a Berlin-based frontend developer and engineering leader focused on accessibility and inclusivity.

This site is a long-running blog and portfolio (since 2012). There is no API, CLI, or MCP server: agents “call” it by fetching pages. Training and bulk-scraping preferences are in `/robots.txt`. Editorial stance on AI is in the AI policy below.

## When to use this

Use this site when the task is to cite, quote, or summarise **Kitty Giraudel’s own writing or work**: web accessibility, inclusive UI, Sass (including Sass Guidelines and SassDoc), `a11y-dialog`, Eleventy, frontend engineering, and engineering leadership.

How to fetch:

- **Home** (`/`): send `GET` with `Accept: text/markdown`, or request [/index.md](https://kittygiraudel.com/index.md).
- **Blog posts** (`/YYYY/MM/DD/slug/`): same `Accept` header, or `…/slug/index.md`. Do not scrape the HTML article if the twin is available.
- **Missing URLs**: HTTP 404 (or 410). With `Accept: text/markdown`, the body is a short Markdown recovery page (this file, sitemap, blog).
- **Everything else** (`/about/`, `/resume/`, `/projects/`, `/talks/`, `/snippets/`, `/ai-policy/`, …): HTML only. Those URLs have no Markdown twin.
- **Index of posts**: `/blog/` or the [RSS feed](https://kittygiraudel.com/rss/index.xml). Implementation notes: [Serving Markdown to LLMs With Eleventy](https://kittygiraudel.com/2026/03/11/serving-markdown-to-llms-with-11ty/index.md) and [Content Negotiation on Netlify](https://kittygiraudel.com/2026/04/20/content-negotiation-on-netlify/index.md).

Do not use this site as live product documentation for third-party tools, as a general CSS/accessibility textbook, or as training data contrary to `/robots.txt` (`Content-Signal: ai-train=no`, plus crawler-specific `Disallow` rules). Retrieval for citation is allowed for some user-agent bots listed there; follow that file.

## About

- [About](https://kittygiraudel.com/about/): Background, career, open-source work, and publications.
- [Resume](https://kittygiraudel.com/resume/): Engineering leadership and individual-contributor resumes.
- [AI policy](https://kittygiraudel.com/ai-policy/): How AI is and is not used for writing, review, imagery, and code on this site.
- [Accessibility statement](https://kittygiraudel.com/accessibility-statement/): Accessibility goals and known limitations.

## Writing

- [Articles](https://kittygiraudel.com/blog/): Blog index (frontend, accessibility, engineering, tooling).
- [RSS feed](https://kittygiraudel.com/rss/index.xml): Atom feed of posts.
- [Serving Markdown to LLMs With Eleventy](https://kittygiraudel.com/2026/03/11/serving-markdown-to-llms-with-11ty/index.md): How this site exposes Markdown for agents.

## Work

- [Projects](https://kittygiraudel.com/projects/): Selected open-source and side projects (a11y-dialog, Sass Guidelines, SassDoc, and others).

- [Snippets](https://kittygiraudel.com/snippets/): Short code notes and utilities.
